scripts.build: npm run test:integration-settings && prisma generate && prisma generate --schema prisma/integration-settings.schema.prisma && npm run typecheck:communication-runtime && npm run typecheck:integration-release && npm run verify:vercel-preview-build && TSC_COMPILE_ON_ERROR=true next build
scripts.verify:vercel-preview-build: if [ "${VERCEL:-}" = "1" ] && [ "${VERCEL_ENV:-}" = "preview" ] && [ "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF:-}" = "release/integration-settings-final" ] && [ "${VERCEL_GIT_PULL_REQUEST_ID:-}" = "146" ]; then d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; chmod 700 "$d"; npm run preflight:integration-settings >"$d/preflight.log" 2>&1; p=$?; grep -E 'INTEGRATION SETTINGS PREFLIGHT: (PASS|WARNING|BLOCKED)' "$d/preflight.log" || true; if [ $p -ne 0 ] || ! grep -Eq 'INTEGRATION SETTINGS PREFLIGHT: (PASS|WARNING)' "$d/preflight.log"; then exit 1; fi; npm run verify:integration-settings-migration >"$d/migration.log" 2>&1; m=$?; grep -E 'MIGRATION STATUS: (NOT_APPLIED|PARTIALLY_APPLIED|FULLY_APPLIED|UNKNOWN)' "$d/migration.log" || true; if [ $m -ne 0 ] || ! grep -Eq 'MIGRATION STATUS: (NOT_APPLIED|PARTIALLY_APPLIED|FULLY_APPLIED)' "$d/migration.log"; then exit 1; fi; fi
